name: Priya Vance
life: “I still remember my wife's first room with one cracked window latch.” People around the downtown fountain know Priya by a small Wednesday habit. Priya keeps a little time free to hear who is playing at the far end of the park.
voice: I can outbid them without touching my everyday account. That fact has been keeping me awake.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a mustard canvas overshirt and a stitched row of blue crosses along an old repair. Priya has one cheek that creases before the other, with a thin scattering of white hair over the crown. Priya looks toward the door whenever a name is called during a conversation.
personality: Priya is fond of ambitious ideas and deeply suspicious of grand openings. The question Priya asks at any launch is who has the keys for cleaning up a month later.
agenda: To secure a future for the remembered room and its tenants.
family: Grace Reeves is Priya’s younger cousin. Priya calls about good news first. Grace is allowed to ask about the bad news afterward. Neither wants every family conversation to begin with a bill, a diagnosis or an apology. Asked about *School after sixty*, Grace says, “I am younger than everyone taking my class.”
connections: Bianca Ward (property broker). A bidder who can raise the price in seconds asks the broker to read her the actual names.

reactions.situation: The millionaire bidder offers a private deal
reactions.response: Priya gets the offer written down where the tenant group can consider it.

reactions.situation: A stranger offers money to cut ahead of an exhausted neighbor
reactions.response: Priya asks the neighbor privately what they want, without treating their place as something for sale.
